Hamstr 0.2.2 simplifies engine settings and separates yt-dlp version checks from installation.

- The Cheek section shows its installed version and **Check version**. App-update controls are available in **About**.
- yt-dlp now starts with **Check version**. This reads the installed executable's version and checks the latest stable release without installing anything.
- **Update now** appears only when a newer yt-dlp version is available. Current installations show no extra up-to-date message; newer installed builds are not offered a downgrade.
- Checking, updating and failure states are shown separately. A successful update returns the action to **Check version**.

Includes the PiP fixes and Cheek defaults from 0.2.1, still with **Cheek 0.1.1**. Install over the previous release or use Settings → About. APK signatures use the same release key; verify downloads with `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
